parts.text: Write a short LinkedIn-style post (under 100 words, English) about why our team switched to a new expense system.

Receipt chasing is officially a thing of the past! 🛑🧾

Our team used to dread end-of-month expense reports. Lost receipts, manual data entry, and endless approval loops were draining our time and energy. 

That’s why we finally made the switch to a new expense platform. 

Now? Snapping a photo of a receipt takes 5 seconds, approval workflows are automated, and reimbursements land in accounts in days, not weeks. 

More time for the work that matters, less time drowning in paperwork. 

What’s your team’s favorite hack for beating admin fatigue? Let me know below! 👇

#Productivity #TeamCulture #FinanceOps #WorkSmarter
